verified.method: Verified on rendered images (viewed by the builder): the pages of the company screenshots PDF rendered by tool_shots.py – the 220-DPI zoomed crop of the column-header strip + the whole financing section and the 150-DPI full page(s) with the highlight boxes – and the other pages of the consolidated statement (operating / investing / appendices, 120 DPI). Compared with the final data: every line text, every value digit by digit (5 columns x 5 lines + total; the blank FY cell of the bond line = 0 (also zoomed with tool_grid at 250 DPI)), the column headers (periods, audit status), the units/currency, the item mapping, and the (*) lines outside financing. Operating p. 36 ('מסים ששולמו, נטו') and investing p. 37 ('ריבית שהתקבלה', 'דיבידנד שהתקבל') hold no interest/dividend-paid line. C1 = 0 in every column. The text layer was used only to locate pages and to read supporting pages (balance sheet / notes / equity statement) for the mapping decisions.
